title: LinkedIn Client Hunting: Find Every Target Company Page
coverSub: From a list of company names to their LinkedIn pages
cover: In this video we are going to see how to do LinkedIn client hunting: find every target company page using LinkFinder AI.
payoff: Here is what you end up with. 7 company names went in, and every one came back with its LinkedIn page, ready to export. Now let's see how.
outro: That's the whole flow: a list of companies in, LinkedIn pages out. Click the first link in the description to create your free account and run your own list. Next, watch how to find the people who work at these companies.
outroSub: Free account, credits included. First link in the description.

mocks._source: Real results from the LinkFinder AI API (data/lookups.json), checked by tools/gen360.py

click.text: I just need one lookup for now

steps.narration: Pick a company's LinkedIn page, from its name. One credit per company.

click.text: A company's LinkedIn page, from its name

steps.narration: Fill in the company name. We type J.B. Hunt.
In a couple of seconds you get their LinkedIn company page.
Now do it for a whole list. Click Upload CSV, bulk.
Click Select File and pick your CSV. One column of company names is enough. Ours has 7, from Schneider National to Zillow.
You see the rows before anything runs, so you know exactly what you will spend.
The LinkedIn pages come in row by row while you watch.
7 companies in, 7 LinkedIn pages out, every one marked Found.
Click Export to download the list as a CSV, ready for your CRM or your next enrichment.
